queries: WITH line AS (SELECT link_to_budget, SUM(cost) AS total_cost, COUNT(*) AS n FROM expense WHERE link_to_budget IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_budget), avg_all AS (SELECT AVG(total_cost) AS avg_total FROM line) SELECT AVG(l.total_cost) AS avg_total_above, SUM(l.n) AS total_expenses, AVG(l.total_cost - a.avg_total) AS avg_excess FROM line l CROSS JOIN avg_all a WHERE l.total_cost > a.avg_total

WITH line AS (SELECT link_to_budget, SUM(cost) AS total, COUNT(*) AS n FROM expense WHERE link_to_budget IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_budget), avg_t AS (SELECT AVG(total) AS a FROM line) SELECT AVG(l.total) AS avg_total, SUM(l.n) AS total_expenses, AVG(l.total - t.a) AS avg_excess FROM line l CROSS JOIN avg_t t WHERE l.total > t.a

WITH line AS (SELECT link_to_budget, SUM(cost) AS total, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM expense WHERE link_to_budget IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_budget), avg_t AS (SELECT AVG(total) AS a FROM line) SELECT AVG(l.total) AS avg_total, SUM(l.cnt) AS total_expenses, AVG(l.total - t.a) AS avg_excess FROM line l CROSS JOIN avg_t t WHERE l.total > t.a

responses.sql: WITH line AS (SELECT link_to_budget, SUM(cost) AS total_cost, COUNT(*) AS n FROM expense WHERE link_to_budget IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_budget), avg_all AS (SELECT AVG(total_cost) AS avg_total FROM line) SELECT AVG(l.total_cost) AS avg_total_above, SUM(l.n) AS total_expenses, AVG(l.total_cost - a.avg_total) AS avg_excess FROM line l CROSS JOIN avg_all a WHERE l.total_cost > a.avg_total

assumptions.assumption: Expenses with a NULL link_to_budget are not a budget line and are excluded from the grouping and the average.
All expenses are included regardless of the approved flag, since the request does not filter on approval.
If no line is above the average (e.g. all totals equal), the query returns one row with NULL averages and NULL expense count.

assumptions.assumption: Expenses with NULL link_to_budget are excluded, since they do not belong to any budget line.
All expenses are included regardless of the approved flag, since the request does not mention filtering on it.
The 'average amount by which totals exceed that average' is the mean of (total - overall average) over the above-average lines.
